name: TeslaMate-ABRP
description: Sync TeslaMate data to A Better Route Planner to avoid issues with your Tesla sleeping

variables.name: MQTT Username
variables.description: Username if you are running MQTT in secure mode. Empty is no user

variables.name: MQTT Password
variables.description: MQTT password if running in secure mode. Empty if not

variables.name: ABRP User Token
variables.description: This is the token provided by ABRP

variables.name: Car Number
variables.description: This is your car number, if you only have one vehicle then this will be 1

variables.name: Car Model
variables.description: Your car model. When this value is not set, the script will try to determine your car model automatically (this should work for Models S, X, 3 and Y with standard configs). The detection is very bare-bones and will not take into account factors such as wheel type, heat pump, LFP battery.
